title: Concept: NuGet feed password stored in nuget.config
description: nuget.config declares a feed password written directly into the checked-in NuGet configuration, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Everyone who can read the repository can pull private packages as that account, and the value also lands in restore logs.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: Everyone who can read the repository can pull private packages as that account, and the value also lands in restore logs.
